decision_reason: The Dk64 and PDC-coexistence decisions remain rejected and preserved as separate scientific questions. The corrected 40960-budget no-cache versus HYPIC-only TP4 reproduction completed 18/18 independently audited units. HYPIC changed mean TTFT by -43.6345%, TPOT by -18.9911%, output throughput by +36.0663%, and duration by -26.6028%, closely reproducing the employee performance direction and magnitude. LongBench-v2 changed by -0.2625pp and GSM8K by -0.1516pp; both are within measured baseline repeat ranges. Adoption is authorized for this frozen workload with quality monitoring, not as a universal lossless claim.
